page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew and Greek words inline; no marginal notes of its own (faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored). Running head at top; signature at foot.

main_text.p: לִקְטַ Ch.& Syr.Colligere, ut Hebr. Pahel לִקַּם Idē, Partic. מְלַקֵּט Collector sermonum, h. e. Garrulus, Blatero, ταρεμόλογος, Act.17.18.
לִקְטָא Ch. Collectio, Collectaneum, Sordes in inglu- vie collectæ. Plural. זְלוּקְפִיהּ בְּלִקְטֵיהּ Ingluviem cum collectaneis ejus, Levit.1.16. Jon.
מַלְקְטָא Chald. Forceps, Emunctorium. Plural. מַלְקְטִין מַלְקְטַיָּא Forcipes, Hebr. מַלְקָחַיִם.
לקן לַקְנָא Ch. Simpulum: Lagena, Jud.6.38. Idem videtur quod suprà לַגִינָא, litteris homogeneis permutatis.

לקש לְקִישָׁא, לְקִישׁ, לַקִּישׁ Ch. Serotinū: Serotina pluvia. Plur.masc.emph. לְקִישַׁיָּא Serotina, Serotinæ pecudes vel oves, Genef.30.42. רִסִיסִין לְקוּשִׁין Stillæ serotinæ, id est, pluviæ, Deut.32.2. in Jon. Sic Syr. ܡܠܩܘܫܐ Pluvia serotina, Jacob.5.7. Fœm. לְקִישָׁן Serotini fructus, Exo.9.32.Jon.
לקישות Ch. Tardatio, Serotinatio: בְּלִקִּישׁוּת עֲנָא In serotinatione ovium, id est, cùm sero coirent. Genef. 30.42.in Onk. In Jonath. בְּלָקוּשֵׁי.
לשך לִשְׁכַּתָא, לִשְׁכָּא Ch.Cubiculū, cella, לִשְׁכַּת רִבְרְבֵיא Cœnaculum principum,Jerem.35.4. Plur. לִשְׁכִּן, E- zech.40.17.
לשן לִשַׁן, לִישָׁנָא, לִשְׁנָא, לְשַׁן Ch. & Syr. Lingua: לִישַׁן תְּלִיתָאי Lingua, tertia; Linguâ tertiâ loqui,

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek and Syriac words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; Hebrew vowel points are approximate in places. The Syriac word in the sixth-to-last entry and the Greek word ταρεμόλογος are uncertain.
